definitions.explanation: A brief, general description of something without going into full detail. Used to provide the main points or gist of a topic.

examples.japanese: {概略|がいりゃく}を{説明|せつめい}する。
プロジェクトの{概略|がいりゃく}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me the overview of the project.

examples.japanese: {概略|がいりゃく}だけでも{把握|はあく}しておきたい。
examples.english: I want to at least grasp the general outline.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{概|がい} (general, approximate) + {略|りゃく} (abbreviation, summary)

USAGE:
Used in business and academic contexts when:
・Giving a high-level overview
・Summarizing complex topics
・Providing initial explanations

COLLOCATIONS:
・{概略|がいりゃく}を{述|の}べる - to state an outline
・{概略|がいりゃく}{説明|せつめい} - summary explanation

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{概要|がいよう} - summary, overview
・{大筋|おおすじ} - general outline
